title: eat shit & die 147
author: bpatrick
hoverText: He switches to Benson & Hedges for the appropriate arty pretension
body: Last comic of ’09. Wow. I’m looking forward to the new year. Here’s to (hoped-for)comic-greatness in ’10.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: Fuckin’ A. Nice one, man. I’ll see you in 2010.
